items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Who did you remember, Fon? [INTERVIEWEE] I didn't see them much.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. See how about the bazooka players? Who was all playing bazooka right there? Oh yeah. Bazooka, the shoddy, and the perka. You ain't talking about dance. No, you mean the bazooka horn. Oh, bazooka horn. I took you in today. Oh, I didn't see them much.

I didn't see them much. I remember two boys Boise and another boy. We got so many different kinds of issues right now. You see those boarding people, you know, kind of savage. They come through the origin kind of horn, you know. They make good music like them, how are you? They make good music with them.
